title: FlowShowOutput
description: Output of `gentry flow show --json`: the active flow of the project with its texts, or with --draft the draft. With an object flag the arrays narrow to the object and what it refers to: for a scenario its stages, their parts and subagents; for a stage its parts and subagent; for a part or a subagent the object alone.

version.description: Number of the active flow version; absent if the project has no flow yet, which only the draft can show.

draft.title: FlowDraftInfo
draft.description: The open draft of the flow; absent if there is none.

dir.description: Absolute path of the draft directory.

base_version.description: Number of the version the draft was made from; absent if the project had no flow.

id.description: Identifier of the scenario, the name of its file.

title.description: Name of the scenario shown to the operator.

nodes.description: Nodes of the scenario graph in the order of the scenario file.

id.description: Identifier of the node, unique within the scenario. One stage may stand in several nodes.

stage.description: Identifier of the stage of the node.

next.description: Transitions from the node, always a list, even when the scenario file has one node identifier. At most one is without a condition: the default path.

to.description: Identifier of the target node, or finish for the end of the scenario.

if.description: Condition of the transition as text, evaluated by the agent; absent for the transition of the default path.

max_rounds.description: Limit of rounds of the loop the transition closes; absent when the transition closes no loop.

id.description: Identifier of the stage, the name of its files.

title.description: Name of the stage shown to the operator.

exit.description: Exit of the stage: what must be true to close it.

executor.description: Who carries out the stage: orchestrator for the main agent session, operator for the operator, otherwise the identifier of a subagent of the project or of the library.

include.description: Identifiers of the parts included in the instruction of the stage, in the order of the stage file; empty if none.

instruction.description: Instruction of the stage in markdown, as written.

id.description: Identifier of the part, the name of its file.

text.description: Text of the part in markdown, as written.

agents.description: Subagents by identifier: those of the project and those of the library the stages name. A project subagent replaces a library one of the same identifier.

id.description: Identifier of the subagent, the name of its files.

source.description: Where the subagent comes from: project for a subagent of the flow, library for a copy of a subagent of the library taken into the version.

capabilities.description: What the subagent may do, in the order of its file.

instruction.description: Instruction of the subagent in markdown, as written.
